name: Whole cow's milk
foamingProperties: Froths well and gives dense, stable foam
description: A classic choice for cappuccino and latte. Fat content depends on the producer and is printed on the package.

name: Skim milk
foamingProperties: Creates voluminous foam easily, but it is usually airier and less creamy
description: Milk with minimal fat. It is less noticeable in the cup, so the coffee stays in the foreground.

name: Oat milk
foamingProperties: Depends on the brand; "barista" editions usually froth better
description: One of the most common plant-based alternatives in coffee shops. It pairs well with espresso.

name: Soy milk
foamingProperties: Usually froths well; may curdle in very hot or acidic coffee
description: A long-standing plant-based alternative to cow's milk. For coffee it is better not to overheat it.

name: Almond milk
description: A light plant-based alternative with a nutty accent. It suits cold drinks.
